en: %s begins chanting as he mixes the well stones and ambercorn before the Tribal Fire.
I have changed my mind loyal servants, you do not need to bring the prisoner all the way to my study, I will deal with him here and now.
%s sees his fans cheering and gains a burst of speed!
Hail, traveler! What brings you to my doorstep?
Well, I'm off to Ratchet now! Best of luck to you!
Excellent! I've been hopin' for a new student. Well, let's get started right away then!
Go Forsaken!  Yay us!
This foul little beast is the imp. It is small and weak, making it almost useless as a meatshield, and its damage output is mediocre at best. This creature is best used for support of a larger group.
Farewell, $n.  And remember, a warrior never shows his back to his foe!
It's 40 degrees Kraklenheit. Can you feel the heat? No? I really couldn't either.
We have won $2219W battles against the Scourge.  Stand firm, $n!  We must persevere!

The power of Elune compels you!  The power of Elune compels you!  

Go now!  Seek out Jandria in the central hall of the Temple of the Moon in the southern section of Darnassus!
You cannot hide from us, little paladin!

How else could this have happened? Someone must have tipped the Dark Irons off.$B$B<Kharan shakes his fist at you.>$B$BSo help me, if I ever get out of here, I will spend the rest of my days finding the traitor.
%s begins to summon a lava spawn!
Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?
Stranger, find the fallen Prince Menethil and end his reign of terror.

Yeah, I've heard through the grapevine that I might be seeing you sooner or later. But I don't just take on anyone, I need to make sure you have what it takes first. You willing to take my little test and find out?
My feet hurt.
$G Master:Mistress; $n! Master Kang has been asking about you! Perhaps it is your time!
No! The Defias will surely take the farm now!
Xon'cha will stable your extra pets.  Find him in the Valley of Honor at the stables between the arena and the Hunter's Hall.  Now begone!
Greetings, $c.  If you're a friend of Colonel Kurzen then I'll have you cut down where you stand! but if you've come to aid us, then lend an ear...
A gloom shrouds our lands, young $c.  Will you take up arms to face this flying death?
So dark...
%s goes into a drunken rage!
Hail, $c.  There is a great need and even greater honor and renown to be had in Alterac Valley at this time. Will you join our fight against the Stormpike Guard?
You must listen, young $c.  Listen to the whisperings in the darkness, for they offer guidance in these troubled times.
The League of Arathor is trying to reclaim their ancestral holdings in Arathi Basin from the Forsaken.  If you would aid them $n speak to Donal Osgood in the Hall of Arms.
I don't see how these foul animals live in this place... sheesh it smells!

Well, well, moving up in the world are we? You're looking for the Champions' Hall, and you'll find it on the southeast end of Old Town. If you're an officer you can enter the hall, otherwise you can still speak to Officer Areyn standing outside. Good luck!
What is Dreadnaught armor?
I will access the discs now.
I'm ready, sir! Just give the word and I will rain down hellfire upon their base!
Still with us, Reethe?
Enough talk you two!  Commence fighting!
I require training, Daryl.
%s is silenced by the venomous sting.
The battle for Warsong Gulch begins in 30 seconds.  Prepare yourselves!
It's Komak... Better get out of his way.
Let's go, honey.
Everyone ready?
Warrior trainers fight good.  You find them in War Quarter on outer ring of Undercity.
